tools.quote: Bond University is committed to providing equitable access to Gen-AI tools for students and staff. The University has acquired licenses for all staff and students to use the following tools.
Only promote the use of the University-approved AI tools

Although these are not included in the University’s preferred tools, we recognise that their unique capabilities mean they can assist students and staff in their work. These tools pose greater risks to privacy, intellectual property and security than preferred tools.
Bond University does not provide support for these tools, nor has the University approved any desktop-based software that may be associated with those solutions.
